content: Amisye anajo indamu Po inapaya irati vatano aarurijate mansai
Ransyerano Israel ukiny dai arono wanya usea no Yavaro Amisy no Yerusalem.

content.text: Syo AMISY awain arono rino irati ana nsosobe ama uga rai,
muno Po sya ana danajo raveti mamaisy.
Sya AMISY, syare Nyo inapaya irati vatano wo aarurijate raker,
Inya, vatano wasaunane mansake weap, animaisye mi indati Amisye Po raugaje ratutumbe tavono wasai?
Muno mangke mbetai ruimaisye mirati indati Po raugaje wasai?
Wepi Po naite maveti wo ato nsasiu veano wasaivuiny,
muno nuja ama nene nsundive rave
Wakoe, kakaije nde rinai weye rino vatano wanave Amisye Ai jewene matavon,
maisyare vatano mamun Mesek muno Kedar awa yasyine wemaisy.
rino irati vatano wonae kovo saumane rai umaso matavon.
Risyamo ibekero kovo saumane rai, weramu ranivara syayao dai,
weamo onawamo ubekero ivuinye obo rai.

footnotes.text: nuja ama nene nsundive rave: Ayao Ibrani maisyare so: ‘‘nuja arar ama nene nsundive.’’ Nuja arar somamo inyo matu maisyare maraande ramaisy.
